description:
After retiring from being a beloved idol, Lee Hyun-Seul struggles with depression and wastes his time, while Yoon Ho-Min, an art student struggling in poverty, holds on to his dream of becoming an artist. One day, Hyun-Seul stumbles upon an exhibition and is deeply comforted by Ho-Min's paintings. However, when Ho-Min tells him that his paintings aren't for sale, Hyun-Seul conceals his identity and begins to hover around Ho-Min, determined to get his hands on them. From that day on, Ho-Min is bewildered by a series of unexpected opportunities. Will Hyun-Seul be able to avoid Ho-Min's attention and obtain the paintings?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
